P.name: Power Chord
P.title: Template:Data Sona/Power Chord
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Power Chord|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Sona |skill = I |icon = Sona Power Chord.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate - Accelerando:}} {{ci|Sona}} gains a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Accelerando'' each time she hits an enemy champion with ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}''. If she has max stacks, she instead {{sti|cdr|reduces}} the cooldown of ''{{ai|Crescendo|Sona}}'' each time. |blurb2 = [[File:Sona Power Chord 3.gif|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Innate - Melody:}} '''Sona's''' {{tip|abilities|basic abilities}} incur a {{sti|cd|brief}} cooldown on her other basic abilities, and cause her to generate a unique {{tip|aura}} for a short time that empowers herself and nearby allied champions. |blurb3 = [[File:Sona Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Innate - Power Chord:}} '''Sona's''' basic abilities generate permanent stacks of ''Power Chord''. At 3 stacks, her next basic attack consumes them all to become empowered with bonus magic damage and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability cast. |blurb4 = [[File:Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Accelerando:}} For each stack, '''Sona''' gains {{sti|ah|basic ability haste}}. |description = {{sbc|Innate - Accelerando:}} '''Sona''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Accelerando'' each time she hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'', stacking up to 120 times. At maximum stacks, she instead reduces the {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} of ''{{ai|Crescendo|Sona}}'' by {{fd|1.5}} seconds each time.

[[File:Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Accelerando:}} For each stack, '''Sona''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} basic ability haste}}}}, up to {{as|60|ah}} at maximum stacks. |icon2 = Sona Power Chord 3.gif |description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Melody:}} Whenever '''Sona''' casts a {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, her other basic abilities incur a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} global cooldown and she generates a unique {{tip|aura}} for 3 seconds that empowers herself and nearby allied champions. Only one aura can be active at a time. |description3 = {{sbc|Innate - Power Chord:}} '''Sona's''' basic abilities generate a stack of ''Power Chord'', stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, her next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to consume them all to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|{{pp|20 to 80 for 7;90 + (240-90)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=10 + 10 per level until level 8, then + 15 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability she cast: * ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Staccato:}} '''Bonus''' damage is modified to {{as|{{pp|20*1.5 to 80*1.5 for 7;90*1.5 + (240*1.5-90*1.5)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=15 + 15 per level until level 8, then + 22.5 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}. * ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Diminuendo:}} Reduces the target's {{tip|size}} by 8% and damage dealt by 25% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 3 seconds. * ''{{ai|Song of Celerity|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Tempo:}} {{tip|Slows}} the target by 50% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 2 seconds, capped at 99%. |description4 = ''Gaining Power Chord's empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sona's''' basic attack timer.'' |targeting = Passive |affects = Self |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = True |spelleffects = proc |parry = True |notes = * ''Power Chord'' stacks are represented by a counter under '''Sona's''' [[health bar]], visible to the player only. It will light up when the empowered effect is available. ** When ''Power Chord'' is ready, '''Sona''' gains a ring around her. This ring will have a different color depending on the last ability used (''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona|blue}}, {{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona|green}} or {{ai|Song of Celerity|Sona|purple}}''). ** The effect does not change if abilities are used while the projectile is in motion. * The triggering attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal. * '''Sona''' retains ''Power Chord's'' stacks when entering {{tip|resurrection}}. * The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|wards}} and [[jungle plants]]. }}

Q.name: Hymn of Valor
Q.title: Template:Data Sona/Hymn of Valor
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Hymn of Valor|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Sona |skill = Q |icon = Hymn of Valor.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sona}} projects sound bolts to the two nearest enemies that each deal {{as|magic damage}}, and she gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' for each bolt that damages an enemy {{tip|champion}}. |blurb2 = [[File:Sona Hymn of Valor 2.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on their next attack {{tip|on-hit}} within a few seconds. |blurb4 = {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Power Chord}} – Staccato:}} ''Power Chord'' deals {{as|'''increased''' magic damage}}. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' sends out bolts of sound to the two nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, prioritizing champions. Each bolt deals {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area around the target for 1 second.

'''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' for each bolt that hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}. |leveling = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 190}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}} |icon2 = Sona Hymn of Valor 2.png |description2 = {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on their next attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds. |leveling2 = {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% of '''Sona's''' AP)}}}} |cooldown = 8 |cost = {{ap|50 to 70}} |costtype = mana |cast time = none |effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|825|Sound bolts search range}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|400|Aura radius, center-to-edge}}}} |speed = {{tt|1300|Sound bolts missile speed}} |targeting = Auto |affects = Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = True |spelleffects = special |grounded = |knockdown = |projectile = True |notes = * The bolts deal {{tip|area damage}} while the attacks, while the {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}}}} empowered attacks deal {{tip|proc damage}}. * Sight of the targets' area is granted on-cast. * The {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}}}} empowerment given to tagged allies respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}. * The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against [[ward]]s. }}
